hooks.name: Gate every spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task runs, the agent runs lint, typecheck and tests, ticks the task and records real bugs in the decision log.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Before calling it done: 1) run `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` and fix failures without weakening tests; 2) tick the task in .kiro/specs/seance-kit/tasks.md; 3) if a test or property caught a real bug, add a short entry to the decision log in KIRO_USAGE.md and keep any shrunk counterexample as a regression test.
